result: Addressed all three reviewer findings and produced an exact-SHA green package: the public bundle has no reusable room authority, multiple independent rooms persist and reload without master-tab collisions, and permanent CI protects the production HTTPS contract.

test_change_summary.scenario_risk: Reusable public-bundle authority, cross-room state/credential collision, durable restore of multiple rooms, and loss of the production regression outside PR519.
test_change_summary.reuse_or_new_reason: Extended the two existing VTT scenarios instead of adding a duplicate suite: production HTTPS now asserts a secret-free bundle and two isolated durable rooms; the local room scenario asserts no launch bearer and per-tab master authority.

limitations: The verified HTTPS environment is ephemeral and not an owner-accessible durable/public stand.
No publication or merge to main was authorized or performed.
The normal Pages build remains VTT-disabled when no room-service URL is configured.
